description: Header file defining data structures and API for Red-Black Tree implementation in C, including tree node, tree, and iterator structures, along with macros and function prototypes.

methods.name: ds_tree_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the tree is empty.

methods.name: ds_tree_next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_prev
methods.description: Returns the previous element in the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_find
methods.description: Finds an element in the tree by key.

methods.name: ds_tree_remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_ifirst
methods.description: Returns the first element in the tree iterator.

methods.name: ds_tree_inext
methods.description: Returns the next element in the tree iterator.

methods.name: ds_tree_iremove
methods.description: Removes the current element in the tree iterator.

methods.name: ds_tree_check
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the tree.

methods.name: ds_tree_graphviz
methods.description: Outputs a Graphviz representation of the tree.
